title: Terms of Sale
body:
These terms apply to orders placed with NEXTDROP.

### Placing an order
This website is a catalogue. Clicking an order button opens a message to us; it does not place, confirm or reserve an order. An order is only accepted when we confirm it to you by message, including the final price, availability and delivery details.

### Prices
Prices are shown in GBP (£). Delivery is £5 per order. Your final total is confirmed before your order is accepted. If a price shown on the website is wrong, we will tell you before accepting your order.

### Availability
Products are subject to availability. Sizes and colours shown are those listed by us; availability is confirmed when you order.
